description: Resolve one drug name to its FDA identity, then fan out in parallel across the bounded per-drug openFDA endpoints and merge into one profile: identity, label highlights, adverse-event summary, recall history, Drugs@FDA approval, and shortage status. Replaces chaining openfda_get_drug_label, openfda_search_adverse_events, openfda_search_recalls, openfda_search_drug_approvals, and openfda_search_drug_shortages — and reconciles the identifier drift between endpoints that makes that chaining error-prone. Each section is best-effort: a miss returns null rather than failing the call. For deep dives into any one area, use the dedicated tool.

drug.description: Drug name to profile — brand or generic (e.g. "metformin", "Humira", "Glucophage"). Resolved once to canonical FDA identifiers, which then key every sub-query.

name: openfda_drug_profile

seriousCount.description: Reports flagged serious (serious=1). total − seriousCount covers both non-serious reports and those with no seriousness recorded.

items.description: A reaction term paired with its report count.

total.description: Adverse-event reports naming this drug — every matching report, including those with no seriousness recorded; equals openfda_search_adverse_events meta.total for the same medicinalproduct search.

adverse_events.description: Adverse-event summary aggregated over drug/event, or null when unavailable.

approval.description: Drugs@FDA approval summary, or null when no application matched.

degraded.description: Sub-queries that failed upstream, empty when every section resolved. A section listed here is unknown, not absent — a null section with no entry here genuinely has no FDA record.

items.description: One failed sub-query and why it failed.

message.description: Upstream failure message for this section, truncated.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure reason (e.g. rate_limited, upstream_error, query_error).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `blank_drug_name`: The drug name carries no searchable character — only quotes, backslashes, or whitespace. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

identity.description: Identity resolved once and reused across every sub-query to avoid identifier drift.

generic_name.description: Canonical generic name (openfda.generic_name) — the primary source for meta.fanOutKey.

rxcui.description: RxNorm concept unique identifier, when available.

spl_set_id.description: SPL set ID for the drug label, when available.

warnings.description: Warnings (truncated) — boxed warning or warnings_and_cautions for Rx labels, falling back to the OTC-monograph warnings section.

label.description: Label highlights from drug/label, or null when no label matched.

drug.description: The drug name supplied in the request, echoed back.

fanOutKey.description: Canonical key the structured sub-queries (recall/enforcement, Drugs@FDA approval, shortage) ran against — the resolved generic name, falling back to a brand name, then the input term. The adverse-event sub-queries instead key off the raw input term to match heterogeneous reporter-entered values.

resolvedVia.description: Which endpoint resolved the canonical identity: drug/label, drug/ndc, or none.

notice.description: Guidance when the drug could not be resolved or upstream errors degraded the profile. Absent on a fully populated profile.

recalls.description: Recent drug/enforcement recall actions (may be empty).

items.description: A single recall or enforcement action.

sectionsFound.description: How many profile sections (label, adverse_events, recalls, approval, shortage) returned data.

status.description: Shortage status (Current, To Be Discontinued, or Resolved).

shortage.description: Current or most-recent drug shortage status, or null when none on record.

title: Openfda Drug Profile
